svg.title: Jardim em Ação
svg.desc: Ilustração original do desafio Jardim em Ação.
svg.metadata: {"generator": "image_gen built-in", "prompt": "Use case: illustration-story. Use the attached artwork ONLY as a STYLE and CHARACTER REFERENCE: reproduce its polished detailed pixel-art rendering, crisp small pixels, beautiful dimensional lighting, cozy Brazilian indie adventure atmosphere and the SAME Black teenage heroine with dark brown skin, voluminous short curly afro hair, lavender purple jacket, cream shirt, navy trousers and white-soled sneakers. Create ONE entirely new finished game-selection cover for another VOICES challenge, replacing the whole scene and pose. Wide landscape 20:9 aspect ratio (approximately 1870x841), edge-to-edge artwork for a 640x288 card. Professional rich 16-bit pixel-art key art with readable silhouettes, nuanced dithering, layered scenery and strong focal hierarchy, not generic chunky rectangles. NO text, lettering, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks, HUD, borders, screenshots, photorealism or smooth vector art. All key action should stay within the central 75 percent height for panoramic composition. Challenge: Jardim em Ação. A flourishing sunny community garden beside the neighborhood's herb house. Show the heroine bending slightly and watering one of THREE beautifully arranged rectangular raised soil beds with a small teal watering can. Visible water droplets arc onto young seedlings. The other two beds show healthy leafy crops at different growth stages, making planting, growing and harvesting easy to understand. Include a small charming wooden seed cart with seed sacks and tiny pots on the left, a stone water well with a bucket on the right, a cottage herb shop in the background, flowering trees and a cobblestone path. Warm early morning light, lush sage and emerald foliage, ochre soil, soft teal water and lavender clothing. Rich readable leaves and soil texture, gentle sparkle from water, no magical giant plants, no labels."}
